groups.title: ы / и
groups.explanation: ы is said with the tongue pulled back; и with the tongue forward, like “ee”. Swapping them changes the word.

groups.title: Hard or soft (ь)
groups.explanation: A soft sign makes the consonant before it soft: finish with the middle of your tongue raised, like a tiny “y”.

groups.title: х / к
groups.explanation: х is a raspy, continuous “kh” from the back of the mouth; к is a short stop with no friction.

groups.title: р / л
groups.explanation: р is a tapped or rolled tongue tip; л is a dark “l” with the back of the tongue low.

groups.title: ж / ш
groups.explanation: ж and ш are made the same way, but ж is voiced: your throat buzzes.

groups.title: б / п
groups.explanation: б is voiced and п is not. Russian п has no puff of air, unlike English “p”.

groups.title: д / т
groups.explanation: д is voiced and т is not. Both touch the back of the top teeth, not the ridge behind them.

groups.title: г / к
groups.explanation: г is voiced (like “g” in “go”) and к is not.

groups.title: з / с
groups.explanation: з is a buzzing “z”; с is a hissing “s”.
